create_mlp_basic: create a multi-layer perceptron with specified input and output dimensions using the MLP class
create_mlp_with_hidden: create an MLP with custom hidden layer dimensions and ReLU activation for feature transformation
create_mlp_with_dropout: create an MLP with configurable dropout probability to prevent overfitting during training
create_mlp_with_normalization: create an MLP with batch normalization layers between linear layers and activations
run_mlp_forward: run a forward pass through the MLP module with a batch of input tensors
